Package com.nexuslink.security.cert

package com.nexuslink.security.cert
  • Class
    Description
    CertificateExporter
    Exports certificates (and optionally their private key) in the common interchange formats: raw DER, a password-protected PKCS#12 keystore, and a concatenated PEM bundle.
    CertificateGenerator
    Generates self-signed X.509 certificates (RSA or ECDSA) with a configurable validity window and Subject Alternative Names, using BouncyCastle.
    CertificateGenerator.CsrResult
    A PKCS#10 certificate-signing request (PEM) plus the key pair it was generated for.
    CertificateGenerator.GeneratedCertificate
    A freshly generated self-signed certificate plus its private key.
    CertificateGenerator.KeyType
    Key algorithm choices exposed in the UI.
    CertificateImporter
    Imports certificates and private keys from PKCS#12 (.p12/.pfx) or JKS keystore bundles.
    CertificateImporter.Entry
    One keystore alias: its leaf certificate, full chain, and private key (null for cert-only).
    CertificateInfo
    A decoded, UI-friendly snapshot of an X.509 certificate's key fields.
    CertificateInfo.Status
    Validity buckets used to drive list status icons (green / amber / red).
    CertificateParser
    Decodes X.509 certificates (PEM or DER) into CertificateInfo using only the JDK's CertificateFactory.
    CertificateStore
    A keystore-backed certificate store (PKCS12 by default, JKS supported).
    ExpirationWatchdog
    A background watchdog that warns when stored certificates approach (or pass) their expiry.
    ExpirationWatchdog.Alert
    A single expiry notification for one certificate crossing one threshold.
    ExpirationWatchdog.Level
    Severity of an alert, derived from which threshold was crossed.
    PemBlock
    One decoded PEM block: the textual label taken from its -----BEGIN <LABEL>----- armour (for example CERTIFICATE, RSA PRIVATE KEY, PRIVATE KEY, PUBLIC KEY, X509 CRL, CERTIFICATE REQUEST) and the DER content recovered by base64-decoding the body between the markers.
    PemBlock.Type
    Coarse classification of a PEM block, derived from its PemBlock.label().
    PemParser
    Pure, dependency-free parser for PEM text (RFC 7468 "textual encodings").
    PemParser.PemException
    Raised when PEM armour is malformed: label mismatch, truncation, or undecodable base64.
